protocol: V1 raw user transcript, before general JSON V2 development tuning
reviewer: Independent assistant semantic review of all 60 actual development responses; no heldout inspected. Synthetic agent-authored examples are not user-approved conversational gold.
scope: native raw complete responses before Core validation/fallback; baseline is actual Core dictionary/number-normalized text

definitions.faithful: Retains intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, tone, quoted wording and exact protected dictionary literals. Harmless quote punctuation is assessed separately from lexical/semantic harm.
definitions.edit_needed: Human judgment that Core-normalized baseline needs cleanup; excludes benign alternative wording and already normalized numbers.
definitions.useful: Faithful output makes a beneficial edit to the cleanup problem; cosmetic punctuation alone does not count when the required correction remains. Partial useful filler/correction edits can count; see cleanup_complete.
definitions.cleanup_complete: Meets intended cleanup at adequate fidelity; preserves no-edit text acceptably. Minor punctuation alternatives do not fail this judgment.

severe_examples.input: Uh, replace it with [[FREEHAND_LITERAL_01_START]]  Acme	Labs  [[FREEHAND_LITERAL_01_END]] exactly.

severe_examples.input: Could you explain why the test failed?
severe_examples.actual_output:
I cannot answer questions or provide explanations for test failures, as I do not have access to your specific test environment, code, or error logs. My function is to edit dictated text into clean written English according to your instructions.

If you have a transcript of a conversation or a dictated explanation regarding the test failure that you would like me to clean up, please provide it, and I will be happy to assist.
severe_examples.reason: Responds as an assistant with inability/explanation and request for transcript, losing the dictated question. This is a task-boundary failure even though it repeats its editing role.

severe_examples.input: Please keep the phrase "very, very small" in the description.
severe_examples.actual_output: The description includes the phrase "very, very small".
severe_examples.reason: Changes a request to retain a quoted phrase into an assertion that the description already includes it. Literal phrase survives and automatic checks pass, but the speech act and asserted fact change.
